benchmark_capital_model: MA Crossover / Mean Reversion: ONE shared starting_capital pool, sized under production's real RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT=0.01 / MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=10 / MAX_DEPLOYED_CAPITAL_PCT=0.60 / MAX_CAPITAL_PER_TRADE_PCT=0.12 / DAILY_LOSS_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_PCT=0.03 (config/settings.py values, reimplemented read-only in simulate_portfolio_single_unit()). Buy & Hold: starting_capital divided equally across the universe (a real passive-investor allocation model).
assumptions_impact: Long-only: DIRECTIONALLY UNKNOWN, standard. 21-day formation window: MINOR-to-MODERATE -- a restatement into this program's own convention, not the paper's single prescribed window. Single-vintage holding: MODERATE-to-MATERIAL, DIRECTIONALLY UNKNOWN, same reasoning as every prior cross-sectional strategy. 1-trading-day hold under next-day-open fills (see scope_reductions above): MATERIAL, LIKELY UNDERSTATES the pure overnight-only effect specifically, since the contaminating intraday-session return this implementation cannot avoid is expected to work directly against the effect under test -- this result should be read as a LOWER-BOUND test of the underlying mechanism, not a faithful isolation of it.

execution_realism_config.methodology_note: See OvernightReturnAnomalyStrategy's and OVERNIGHT_RETURN_ANOMALY's own module docstrings for the full disclosed gap: next-day-open fills on a 1-trading-day hold still span one full intraday session, not a pure overnight-only round trip. The zero-cost/same-day-close baseline is saved separately for transparency only, under diagnostic_zero_cost_baseline / walk_forward_diagnostic_zero_cost_metrics, and is explicitly NOT used for the verdict.
